name: Changing Tastes

angles.text: Borstan aims to elevate traditional rustic meals into something grand enough for the Horde capital, highlighting how culinary tastes and tavern menus evolve beyond village staples.
Supplying Borstan's Firepit means venturing deep into contested lands across the sea to bring back exotic meats to Orgrimmar.

faq.answer: Changing Tastes is a culinary task given in Orgrimmar. Borstan, owner of Borstan's Firepit, seeks thicket raptor meat from the distant Wetlands to elevate his tavern's menu above basic village cooking.
faq.q: What is the quest Changing Tastes?

faq.answer: Zamja is an associate or fellow culinary worker in Orgrimmar who suggested adding homestyle raptor dishes to Borstan's Firepit to attract customers who do not usually visit.
Borstan's Firepit is an eatery located in the Horde capital of Orgrimmar, known for serving hearty cooked meats to travelers and locals alike.

While Zamja proposed ordinary homestyle raptor cooking to lure in diners, Borstan wants a grander take on familiar flavors. Inspired by a hunter's tale of giant talons, he chose the thicket raptors found in the Wetlands.
faq.q: Why does Borstan want thicket raptor meat?

aliases: where do i find thicket raptors
faq.answer: Thicket raptors inhabit the excavation sites situated in the Wetlands, an Alliance-leaning region across the Great Sea in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: Where are the thicket raptors located?

faq.answer: Borstan, the proprietor of Borstan's Firepit in Orgrimmar, offers the quest after being inspired by advice from Zamja and a trophy brought back by an adventurous hunter.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Changing Tastes?

sections.body: In the heart of Orgrimmar, Borstan's Firepit is looking to expand its culinary offerings. Zamja suggested introducing homestyle raptor cooking to appeal to travelers missing the comforting, familiar meals of their birth villages. Borstan liked the notion of serving raptor to draw in new patrons, but felt that simply reproducing rural village dishes was unfitting for the great capital of the Horde. Instead, he envisioned a grander, bolder version of the classic staple.
sections.title: Elevating Capital Cuisine

sections.body: Inspiration arrived when a hunter returned to Orgrimmar bearing a massive talon taken from the thicket raptors prowling the excavation sites of the Wetlands. Intrigued by the quality and stature of these beasts, Borstan arranges for adventurers to cross the sea into the Eastern Kingdoms, brave the excavation grounds, and secure prime thicket raptor meat for his roaring fires.
sections.title: The Hunt in the Wetlands

summary: Changing Tastes is an Orgrimmar quest concerning culinary ambition at Borstan's Firepit. Propelled by advice from Zamja and tales of giant raptor talons, Borstan commissions adventurers to travel across the sea to the Wetlands to secure exotic thicket raptor meat.
